name: Paper Lanterns
plainLyrics:
We hang paper lanterns on the old oak tree
Hold the light, don't let it go
Carry it home through the snow (oh-oh)
Cafe on the corner, the radio low
Say goodbye to the summer, say hello
Burn, burn, little flame
Nobody here remembers your name

Rock 'n' roll in the attic, dust on the keys
Hold the light, don't let it go
Carry it home through the snow
Burn, burn, little flame
Nobody here remembers your name
